what_changed.title: Salesforce signs definitive agreement to acquire Listen Labs
what_changed.body: Official story + X (Sep 29, ~1:00 PM PT). AI customer research + human simulation platform (study design, interviews, synthesis, digital twins). Complements Marketing Cloud / Service Cloud / broader AI portfolio. Close expected Q4 Salesforce FY2027 subject to customary conditions incl. regulatory clearance. Price not disclosed. Why it matters: signed deal deepens agentic research/simulation context for Agentforce-adjacent stack — not a new sales-agent SKU on its face.
